title: ChenRay SMP
description: ChenRay SMP – A friendly vanilla survival server for long-term builders and explorers.
body:
# ChenRay SMP Survival Server
A vanilla survival server for long-term players who enjoy building and exploring.

![players](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b10614ab09dd0c738a07e5a94dd471e7fa571485.jpeg)

---

## Core Gameplay
Focused on **technical survival** — survival + redstone. We automate resource farms and work on large-scale projects, all in pure survival without any cheap shortcuts.

Main features:
- Efficient mob farms and loot systems
- Nether hub for fast travel
- Group projects: spawn city, shops, public facilities, and more

![industrial zone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67f53730f52117c8dd0d02bf0ef4808e3ca375dd.jpeg)

---

## Server Info
- Server Name: ChenRay SMP
- Address: `202.189.10.108:130`
- Version: Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.10 (recommended)
- Mode: Survival, Hard difficulty
- Region: Asia
- Language: Chinese / English

---

## World Layout

| World | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| Overworld | Survival, base-building, regular gameplay |
| Nether | Transport network, gold farms |
| End | Enderman farms, shulker shells |
| Shop | Player trading, auction house |

---

## Rules & Community

### Basic Rules
1. No cheating, hacks, or modified clients.
2. No griefing or stealing from others’ builds.
3. Large redstone machines that may cause lag must be reported first.
4. Be respectful and play cooperatively.

### Community Events
- Weekly redstone discussions and small events
- Annual building competitions
- Announcements and chat via QQ / Discord
